deadline.value: Each PhD post is advertised with its own deadline; the departments post pre-defined projects under Vacancies at DTU.
deadline.quote: DTU’s departments often have pre-defined projects. You can find these projects advertised under Vacancies at DTU.

also.quote: The individual research project is carried out within the scientific disciplines in focus at the institute, i.e. Astrophysics, Geophysics, Earth Observation

supervisor.value: The PhD committee assesses the choice of supervisors as part of admission.
supervisor.quote: In connection with admission, the PhD committee further assesses the individual PhD programme and the choice of supervisors.

funding.value: Admission requires a funding plan covering all three years, and the PhD school must ensure the funds are there.
funding.quote: The PhD school must ensure that funds are available for the duration of the study programme and that the funding plan covers all three years.

entry_route.value: Admission requires a Danish Master's degree or an equivalent foreign degree, judged by the head of the PhD school.
entry_route.quote: To be admitted as a PhD student, an applicant must have satisfactory results from one of the following exams | A Danish Master’s degree in engineering.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: Scope from the department page: astrophysics, geophysics and earth observation. Entry and funding come from DTU's university-wide PhD pages.
